text.title: 对着光的两片叶子
text.situation:
露丝把两片落叶对着光举起。它们的绿色深浅不同。窗边示意图描述光合作用：绿色植物用光能把水和二氧化碳转成糖。根吸收水，叶从空气中吸收二氧化碳。叶绿素帮助捕获光。乔顺着箭头，从空气看到叶片，再看到小糖符号；比从头读完整标签容易理解。

乔：图说叶子从土里获得食物吗？
露丝：不是。根吸收水和矿物质，植物利用光制造糖。
玛雅把较浅的叶片放在色卡旁，记录绿色的深浅。

paragraphs.en: Ruth held two fallen leaves against the light. They were different shades of green. A diagram beside the window described photosynthesis: green plants use light energy to make sugars from water and carbon dioxide. Their roots absorb water, while leaves take in carbon dioxide from the air. Chlorophyll helps capture light. Jo followed the arrows from the air to the leaf and then to the little sugar symbol; it was easier than reading the label from top to bottom.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Does the diagram say the leaf gets its food from the soil?
Ruth: No. The roots absorb water and minerals. The plant makes sugars using light.
Maya held the paler leaf beside a colour card and noted its shade of green.
